subject: Evidence-portal integration + artifact timeline for Megalithicorp RFI
messages:
From: Amy Hughes <amy.hughes@megalithicorp.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Byrne <s.byrne@megalithicorp.com>, compliance@megalithicorp.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Megalithicorp RFI — SIG/ISO/SOC2 artifact ingestion options

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has asked us to confirm how Redwood plans to deliver evidence for the Megalithicorp RFI. Two asks up front: (1) a control map that aligns your controls to the SIG questionnaire columns (we can supply the SIG XLSX), and (2) an automated way to upload artifacts (logs, screenshots, policies) into our evidence-tracking workspace — ideally via S3 presigned URLs or an API so our GRC tool can pull them automatically.

Attached is the SIG template we prefer; can you confirm whether your evidence portal supports programmatic ingestion, S3, or a bulk CSV import? Also need an estimated delivery timeline for mapping + first artifact batch (about ~150 items). Our target window is end of month for the first tranche.

Thanks,
Amy
Amy Hughes
Head of Vendor Assurance, Megalithicorp
amy.hughes@megalithicorp.com
+1 415-555-0184

Attachment: megalithicorp-sig-template.xlsx (XLSX)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Amy Hughes <amy.hughes@megalithicorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Megalithicorp RFI — SIG/ISO/SOC2 artifact ingestion options

Amy — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes, we support programmatic ingestion. We can: (A) provide temporary S3 presigned URLs for push uploads; (B) accept artifacts via our evidence-collector API (/api/v1/ingest) with HMAC key; or (C) ingest a bulk CSV that references hosted artifact URLs.

Proposed plan:
- Day 0–2: we upload a completed control map (SIG columns -> Redwood control IDs) and a sample CSV you can validate. I will share the CSV and a small control-map sample (redwood-control-map-sample.csv).
- Day 3–7: onboarding of your automation — we will create a Megalithicorp workspace in the Evidence Portal and issue an HMAC token scoped to ingestion-only, expiring in 30 days.
- Day 7–14: first artifact tranche (up to ~150 artifacts) ingested via presigned URLs or API.

Security notes: tokens are scoped and rotated on request, uploads are scanned, and object metadata supports control_id tagging for quick crosswalks. I can also provide an API guide (evidence-portal-api-guide.pdf) and a sample ingestion script.

I'll loop in our ops lead for control ownership and evidence packaging. Can you confirm the SIG variant (SIG Lite vs SIG Full) and whether you need ISO 27001 mappings as a separate sheet?

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-control-map-sample.csv (CSV)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Megalithicorp RFI — action items and owners

Team — forwarding Megalithicorp request. Please see initial plan I shared. Action items below; can each owner reply with the controls they will own and any blockers by EOD Monday?

Action items:
- Jonas: finalize SIG->Redwood control map (SOC2 + ISO crosswalk as separate sheet). Deliverable: redwood-control-map-sample.csv expanded to full mapping.
- Priyom: evidence-collector API readiness + sample ingestion script (Python) and HMAC token lifecycle notes. Deliverable: evidence-portal-api-guide.pdf + sample script.
- Karthik: artifacts that require legal review (contracts, data processing addenda) — compile first tranche list and flag any PII/xfer concerns.

Notes: Megalithicorp wants a programmatic flow and a ~150 artifact first tranche by 05/31. We should aim for a workspace invite by 05/18 so they can start integrating. Mention if you need a short runbook for their GRC team.

Thanks — Sofia
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Megalithicorp RFI — action items and owners

Sofia, quick status: I'm ~60% through the mapping. A few notes:
- There are ~220 SIG questions in their spreadsheet; about 40 map directly to existing Redwood controls, another 130 require cross-references (we'll add notes column), and ~50 are implementation-level questions where we'll reference artifacts.
- I'll deliver an initial CSV with three columns: sig_question_id, redwood_control_id, evidence_type. That should make it easy for their automation to tag uploads.
- For ISO 27001, I'll add a separate sheet that maps Annex A clauses to the same redwood_control_id values so one artifact can satisfy multiple attestations.

I'll attach the working file with comments. Expect the completed mapping by Tue EOD.

Jonas
Attachment: redwood-control-map-v1.csv (CSV)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Amy Hughes <amy.hughes@megalithicorp.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 May 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence portal workspace invite + ingestion options

Amy / Megalithicorp team —

I've created the Megalithicorp workspace in the Evidence Portal and invited compliance@megalithicorp.com. You should see an email invite titled 'Redwood Evidence Portal — Megalithicorp'.

Technical details (high level):
- API endpoint: https://portal.redwood.com/api/v1/ingest
- Auth: HMAC key in header (X-Redwood-HMAC). We issue a scoped key limited to write-only and prefixed with meg-4932. Keys expire after 30 days by default.
- S3 option: we can generate presigned PUT URLs; the portal will fetch and ingest the object and tag it with control_id metadata if provided.
- CSV bulk import: Accepts a CSV with columns: filename, url, control_id, evidence_type, upload_timestamp. We will validate and report errors in a job output JSON.

I'll attach the API guide and a short sample Python script to show a presigned upload + API notify flow. If you prefer, we can open a short integration call to walk your GRC team through the steps.

Next milestone: portal invite done (today), mapping CSV and first tranche ingestion script by Tue (17 May) EOD — but note Jonas will send the mapping; we can accelerate if needed.

Cheers,
Priyom
Principal Engineer, Customer Integrations

Attachment: evidence-portal-api-guide.pdf, sample-ingest-script.py
From: Amy Hughes <amy.hughes@megalithicorp.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Byrne <s.byrne@megalithicorp.com>, compliance@megalithicorp.com
Date: Wed, 18 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence portal workspace invite + ingestion options

Thanks Priyom — invite received and we validated the API call format with our GRC team (they prefer the presigned PUT + notify pattern). A couple of clarifications before we start ingestion:

1) For artifacts that contain sensitive logs, do you support server-side encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS) on the ingested objects?
2) When an object is ingested and tagged with a control_id, is the metadata queryable via the portal API so our GRC can generate automated evidence reports?
3) Can you confirm retention metadata is attached to each object and that we can request an export manifest (JSON) for the ingest job?

If those three points are yes, we will schedule the bulk push for Fri 05/21 early morning to hedge for any issue. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Amy
